name: A gift beneath Scarlet colors

date.label: Original World of Warcraft Classic · Tirion and Taelan quest chain; exact dating unknown

summary: A disguise opens the way into Hearthglen, where Tirion’s gift can reach Taelan. The Classic chain makes subterfuge the bridge between father and son: the seeker enters the Scarlet Crusade’s stronghold under borrowed colors and gives the package to its Highlord. The banners and pale stone of the settlement frame a tense reunion without placing Tirion there. The audience sees the old family tokens cross a guarded threshold; what Taelan will do with them remains his choice.
